PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: makes the client handle a refused join result, then rejoins
PluginData.Description: Test only, for tests/replicable-hierarchy-after-disconnect/rig.py of the Bugfixes plugin. "refuse" in refused-join-probe.txt in the game's user data folder makes the client handle a UserNotConnected join result the way it does when the server sends one; "join" rejoins the Direct Transport server.
